issues.on_page: Statement of Net Position - Proprietary Fund (Housing column)
issues.issue: Statement is a proprietary fund statement, not a government-wide statement; for a single-fund housing authority it serves the same purpose, but the scope label is not accurate. All 19 balance sheet amounts match and balance (1,369,056 = 45,434 + 1,323,622).
Name printed on the statements is 'Gibbon Housing Agency'; 'Colony Acres' does not appear in the trimmed pages (name appears to come from the manifest/filing).
